about_the_game:
The Sayl the Faithless DLC pack introduces the treacherous sorcerer as a playable Legendary Lord for Immortal Empires and Custom Battles. Sayl leads the Dolgans from the new four-region province of Mountain’s End, rising to power through lies and betrayal.

Sayl’s ascendancy began when he manipulated his tribe into a Daemonic ritual—only to sabotage it, fusing his peers into the Chaos Spawn Nightmaw, his monstrous and mindlessly loyal companion. Unlike his peers’ brute-force tactics, Sayl thrives on cunning and deception.

Unique mechanic: Manipulations

A master schemer, Sayl uses an array of Manipulations to weaken his enemies by disrupting the logistics of their armies, throwing their settlements in disarray and even directly whispering lies that warp and sever their diplomatic ties with friends and neighbours. Even his own forces are subject to the machinations of the Twisted Seer of the Waste in their march to victory and doom. Growing in power unlocks additional Manipulations, ever more potent and treacherous but relying on them is equally as treacherous. Too many Manipulations in a short time span will inevitably attract dark, malevolent Attention that Sayl needs to navigate around or else he will suffer for his transgressions.

Unique Mechanic: Dark Ritual

Ever-thirsty to magnify his sorcerous strength, Sayl strives to enact a great ritual. To do this, he must construct Chaos Altars, allowing him to channel great arcane power. Through enacting rituals, he will face many battles, events and dilemmas in his quest for supreme power, including his greatest challenge, if he is to claim the ultimate prize.

New units

Sayl’s army blends sorcery, monstrosities, and betrayal-driven creations. His unique roster includes:

• Legendary Lord: Sayl the Faithless

• Lord: Great Shaman Sorcerer

• Legendary Hero: Beorg Bearstruck

• Hero: Fimir Noble

• Melee Infantry: Marauder Bearmen (Axe & Shield, Great Weapons)

• Shock Cavalry: Kurgan Horsemen (Dual Weapons, Great Weapons)

• Monsters: Curs’d Ettin, Curs’d Ettin (Runecaller), Chimera, Dread Maw

• 4x Regiments of Renown

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS
  • Processor: 3.4GHz Intel Core i3-4130 or AMD Ryzen CPU equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan, NVIDIA driver version 470.xx or later required (tested), AMD Mesa driver version 23.2.1 or later required (tested), Intel GPUs are not supported at the time of release
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS
  • Processor: 3.4GHz Intel Core i7-4770 or AMD Ryzen CPU equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 8GB or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT 8GB
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan, NVIDIA driver version 470.xx or later required (tested), AMD Mesa driver version 23.2.1 or later required (tested), Intel GPUs are not supported at the time of release

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12.5
  • Processor: Apple M1 (8‑Core CPU) or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 (7‑Core GPU) or better
  • Additional Notes:
      The game is officially supported on all Mac models released since November 2020 with an Apple M1 chip or better. To check your Mac model and when it was released, select About This Mac from the Apple menu on your menu bar.
    ———
      The following Macs are capable of running the game but do not consistently meet the standards required for official support:
    • * All Mac models with an AMD GPU that support macOS 12.5
